q: How does a dye intermediate unit split boiler steam across products?
title: Dye intermediates: steam per product
short: Share the boiler's fuel emissions by steam used per product: from batch records or flow meters if you have them, otherwise by reactor hours. Write down the rule, then divide each product's share by kg produced.
audience: Dye intermediate and specialty chemical units in Gujarat and Maharashtra chemical estates

p: Boiler fuel for the month x its factor.
Steam share per product, from meters or batch logs.
Product share / kg of that product.
Reactor agitators, pumps and chillers run on grid power: add each product's share of kWh x 0.710 (FY 2024-25 grid factor).
